profile.headline: IT Director at UnitedHealth Group
profile.summary: I am a Director of software engineer with a passion for building applications that make people's lives easier. As a professional software developer with years of experience, I have learned the importance of communicating clearly with stakeholders and team members to find the best solutions for them as well as my own development process. The end goal: To deliver high quality software products with efficiency while maintaining solid code. And I know that even if you're just trying to do this, great things will happen. My ideal work environment is collaborative, innovative, and where individuals can learn from each other
